artifact.rationale: Removed the direct AWS Secrets Manager SDK path (boto3 client at secrets.py:41 and GetSecretValue at secrets.py:48; inv:3ccbf876f57f08e8, inv:9de663601b600ca9) and the DB_PASSWORD_SOURCE selection branch. The DB password is now read only from the file at DB_PASSWORD_FILE, which ESO mounts from the OpenBao-backed Secret bravo-demo-db at /var/run/bravo/db/password. config.load() no longer reads DB_PASSWORD_SOURCE, DB_PASSWORD_SECRET_ID/KEY/REGION/ENDPOINT_URL or AWS_REGION. It requires only DB_DSN (no password) and DB_PASSWORD_FILE, so the app starts with the landing-zone interface alone. The old code fails here because it requires DB_PASSWORD_SOURCE. DbSettings keeps password_source as the constant "env-file", so app.py's startup log and secrets.py's load log are unchanged. The secret_* fields that only the removed SM path used are dropped. Nothing else changed: DSN password rejection, S3/attachments, write-block switch, logging. No dependencies, tests, CI or deployment files were touched; boto3 stays because storage.py uses it for the S3-compatible store. The S3 findings (inv:baa6de5a5e72c850, inv:4b2a570efa066af8) already read S3_ENDPOINT_URL etc. from config and need no code change for this task. The chart value findings (inv:ecedbaf5b23990db, inv:c6b9dab5de3d8a70) are deployment files and out of scope. The repo tool output redacted the DSN-check line in config.py. The line was re-entered when the file was rewritten, and make_diff shows no change on it, so it matches the original byte for byte. compile passed. The diff is the verbatim make_diff output.
